title: North Sea oil rig engineer sighting in Jane's

tellings.quote: We ran that story in Jane's Defence Weekly.
He looks up and he sees this dart-like black arrow-shaped thing
tellings.difference: Names the witness, Chris Gibson, credits Bill Sweetman, and describes a dart-like black arrow-shaped craft.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell the same late-1980s North Sea oil rig engineer's sighting that Jane's reported.

as_told.title: Chris Gibson's oil rig sighting of Aurora

plain: In 1989 an engineer on a North Sea oil rig named Chris Gibson is said to have looked up and seen a black, dart-like, arrow-shaped craft. The journalist Nick Cook tells it as a story he ran in Jane's Defence Weekly, a military trade magazine, and credits an aviation writer named Bill Sweetman with the account. If true, it would point to a secret aircraft flying over the North Sea at the time.
